title: Synthetic Data Augmentation for Satellite-Based Analysis of Battle-Damaged Agricultural Fields in Ukraine
abstract: arXiv:2608.16380v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Monitoring war-induced damage to agricultural land in Ukraine is important for understanding threats to food security, environmental stability, and post-war recovery. However, the development of computer-vision systems for satellite-based damage analysis is limited by the scarcity of labeled imagery, especially for damaged agricultural fields. This work investigates synthetic data augmentation as a method for improving classification under limited and imbalanced training data. We train class-conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) architectures on real satellite images and use them to generate additional bombed and not-bombed agricultural-field samples. The generated images are used only for training augmentation, while all downstream evaluation is performed on an exclusively real test set. translated_title: 基于卫星的乌克兰战损农田分析中的合成数据增强
translated_abstract: 监测乌克兰战争对农田造成的损害对于理解粮食安全、环境稳定和战后恢复的威胁至关重要。然而，基于卫星的损害分析计算机视觉系统的发展受到标记图像稀缺的限制，尤其是受损农田的图像。本研究探讨了合成数据增强作为一种在有限且不平衡训练数据下改进分类的方法。我们在真实卫星图像上训练了类条件生成对抗网络（GAN）和去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）架构，并用它们生成额外的被轰炸和未轰炸农田样本。生成的图像仅用于训练增强，而所有下游评估均在纯真实测试集上进行。一个视觉变换器分类器在多种真实和合成数据配置下进行训练。
tldr: 本研究通过使用GAN和扩散模型生成合成卫星图像来增强有限且不平衡的训练数据，从而显著提升了乌克兰战损农田分类的准确性。
en_tdlr: This study improves classification of battle-damaged agricultural fields in Ukraine by augmenting limited and imbalanced training data with synthetic satellite images generated by GANs and diffusion models.
